blocks.text: Got an idea for a comic, a story or a video for school or online? AI is a great partner for brainstorming – and you're the director!
Important: Claude is for adults (18+). So practise the Claude lessons together with a parent, who uses their own account.
Important: you may use ChatGPT from age 13 and only with a parent's permission. If you're younger, practise together with a parent.
Important: you need a parent's permission for Gemini. Younger children can use it only through a parent's Family Link account, where available.
Help me come up with a 6-panel comic about a robot learning to play football. For each panel, write what we see and what the characters say. I'll draw it.
Ask the AI to help with characters, plot and ending – then write it in your own words. You can also ask for "3 different endings" and pick one.
I'm making a 1-minute video about how to make a paper plane. Write me a script: what's on screen, what I say and how long each part lasts.
If you post something online, ask your parents first. And don't use other people's pictures, music or characters without permission.
